name: SonderMind
short_description: SonderMind is a free provider network for therapists with insurance credentialing, billing, and VA partnership.
long_description: SonderMind is a mental health platform that connects therapists with clients while handling insurance credentialing, billing, and client matching. The platform is free for providers to join—therapists work as independent contractors and receive bi-weekly payouts with same-day payment options available. SonderMind offers AI-powered therapist-patient matching and emphasizes measurement-based care. The company is an in-network VA provider, meaning therapy is 100% covered for veterans with a valid referral. SonderMind is headquartered in Denver and works with major insurers including Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Cigna, and UnitedHealthcare.
one_liner: Free therapist network with AI matching, insurance billing, and VA partnership.
best_for: Therapists seeking a free platform to join with no membership fees
